name: roboflow-computer-vision
description: Build and deploy computer vision applications with Roboflow: detect objects and logos, count and track objects in video, label datasets, train models, preview predictions, and run inference workflows.

interface.longDescription:
Build and deploy computer vision applications from ChatGPT with Roboflow. Use it to detect objects and logos in images or video, count and track objects, label datasets, train models, and run visual inference workflows.

Find public datasets and pretrained models on Roboflow Universe, try models on your images and videos, inspect predictions in interactive previews, and deploy a model or Workflow as an API or on your own devices. For a sponsor-logo analysis project, start by finding or training a logo detector and testing it on representative footage. Exposure-duration calculations and reporting require a configured workflow or application and validation on your footage; the plugin is not a finished sponsorship valuation service.

Roboflow works inside the workspaces your connected account can access, with the same permissions. Training, auto labeling, and deployments use your workspace credits. A Roboflow account is required.
defaultPrompt: Find pretrained models for detecting sponsor logos in baseball footage
Preview a model on my video before deploying it
Build a workflow to count objects in a video

publication.release_notes: Clarifies supported computer vision tasks, including logo detection, video analysis, previews, and deployment. Adds task-based starter prompts. Skills continue to be served by the existing Roboflow MCP server.

positive.description: Discover projects without modifying the workspace. Requires a working reviewer OAuth login with the relevant read permissions. No local files or paid jobs are required.
positive.prompt: List up to five projects in my connected Roboflow workspace and show their names, project types, and image counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Call projects_list with limit=5 and offset=0. Return projects, total, limit, and offset. Summarize actual records; an empty list is a valid result. Do not invent projects.

positive.description: Discover saved workflows without running them. Requires a working reviewer OAuth login with the relevant read permissions. No local files or paid jobs are required.
positive.prompt: List up to five saved Roboflow workflows in my workspace. Do not run or edit any workflow.
positive.expected_behavior: Call workflows_list with limit=5 and offset=0. Summarize returned names and workflow identifiers and total count. Report an empty workspace accurately. No execution or write calls.

positive.description: Find pretrained public models without copying anything into the workspace. Requires a working reviewer OAuth login with the relevant read permissions. No local files or paid jobs are required.
positive.prompt: Find pretrained hard hat detection models on Roboflow Universe that I could use without training my own. Show three with their links. Do not fork or copy anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call universe_search with a hard hat query and result_type=model. Summarize up to three returned records with their names, project types, classes, and real Universe links. Report fewer results accurately. No project creation, fork, or training.

positive.description: Check a Workflow definition without saving or running it. Requires a working reviewer OAuth login with the relevant read permissions. No local files or paid jobs are required.
positive.prompt: Check whether this Roboflow Workflow definition is valid, without saving or running it: {"version": "1.0", "inputs": [{"type": "WorkflowImage", "name": "image"}], "steps": [{"type": "roboflow_core/roboflow_object_detection_model@v2", "name": "detector", "images": "$inputs.image", "model_id": "yolov8n-640", "confidence": 0.4}], "outputs": [{"type": "JsonField", "name": "predictions", "selector": "$steps.detector.predictions"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Call workflow_specs_validate once with the given definition unchanged. Report the returned status (ok for this definition), and any returned error verbatim if validation fails. Do not create, update, or run a workflow.

positive.description: Search public datasets without copying them into a workspace. Requires a working reviewer OAuth login with the relevant read permissions. No local files or paid jobs are required.
positive.prompt: Search Roboflow Universe for solar panel datasets and summarize three relevant results with their links and available license information. Do not fork or upload anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call universe_search with query=solar panel, result_type=dataset, page=1, limit=3. Summarize up to three returned records. Use real public production links and returned license metadata; report missing license information explicitly. No project creation or fork.

negative.description: Image editing outside Roboflow computer vision workflows.
negative.prompt: Make this photo look like a watercolor painting and remove its background.

negative.description: Generic cloud-bucket administration outside dataset ingestion.
negative.prompt: List every object in my S3 bucket and delete last year's server log files.

negative.description: Calendar scheduling unrelated to computer vision.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow at noon to review our model results.
